title: Slice commit titled with the Git section's text

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Observed 2026-11-12 (slicer s457): ork's slice commit 51bbad95 is titled "One commit on the slice branch.", the body of the slice's Git section, instead of a title naming the change (earlier slices got e.g. "changelog: per-slice entries in landed-changed/, assembled at release"). Wanted: take the commit title from the implementer's report or the slice title, never from a Git section that carries no title.
